items.text: Nico Collins listed OUT or DOUBTFUL for Sunday with hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring; missed practice all week after Wednesday injury.
items.implication: HOU WR targets redistribute; Stroud volume impacted.
items.opportunity: Zero routes expected; prior week 37 routes on 42 dropbacks.

items.text: Chargers listing WR Ladd McConkey as questionable for Sunday vs Raiders due to rib injury; practiced Friday.
items.why: Ribs; returned to practice after missing Wed/Thu.
items.implication: Biggest slate injury per Levitan; impacts Herbert projections heavily; game at 4pm ET.
items.opportunity: High prior target share; if out, Quentin Johnston boost.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers listed as doubtful for Sunday vs Saints due to hamstring.
items.implication: BAL WR hierarchy collapses to Bateman and others; Mark Andrews target bump possible.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers listed doubtful for Sunday vs Chargers due to knee injury per HC Klint Kubiak.
items.why: Knee; returned to practice Friday but unlikely.
items.implication: Michael Mayer expected elevated role and targets.
items.opportunity: Mayer prior high targets in absence.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (ribs) is biggest injury on the slate, affects so many other projections including Justin Herbert. Game starts at 4pm ET.
items.why: Ribs status uncertainty cascading to offense.
items.implication: Herbert and LAC WR projections heavily adjusted; monitor closely.
items.opportunity: If out, elevated roles for remaining WRs.

items.text: Patriots desperately need playmakers right now, do they give TreVeyon Henderson 10+ touches in his 2026 debut? Returning at right time with AJ Brown on IR and nice matchups ahead.
items.why: Explosive need post AJ Brown IR; favorable schedule stretch.
items.implication: Potential committee shift or lead role vs Stevenson; startable upside.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson listed IN for Sunday; returning for 2026 debut.
items.implication: Potential 10+ touches vs Rhamondre Stevenson; Pats desperate for playmakers with AJ Brown on IR.
items.opportunity: Role expansion possible in favorable upcoming schedule.

items.text: Alvin Kamara listed IN for Sunday.
items.implication: Squeezes Travis Etienne role further in NO backfield.

items.text: Bengals listing QB Joe Burrow as questionable for Sunday at Houston due to back injury; Burrow said he would play.
items.why: Back; coach indicated good to go.
items.implication: Expected to play; CIN offense continuity.

items.text: If Zay Flowers can't go, Ravens WRs look like Rashod Bateman, Devontez Walker, LaJohntay Wester, Elijah Sarratt, Chris Moore. Ja'Kobi Lane on IR/return. BAL down to crumbs at WR.
LOVE Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: Utilization Score of 99 in Week 1 (tied Bijan for lead); 19% target share recent; 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Dominant first game under Kubiak; overreaction to injury scare.

items.text: LOVE Bucky Irving vs CLE: Career-high 26% target share, 8 more routes than Gainwell, both RB red-zone touches in Week 1; CLE allowed 121 rush yards/4.8 YPC.
items.why: Clear lead role and receiving work.

items.text: LOVE Kenneth Walker vs IND: 24% target share (tied team lead, 2nd-highest career) in first game with Chiefs; 21/24 RB touches through 3Q; IND gave up 163 yards/3 TDs to Henry.
items.implication: RB1 overall range of outcomes if healthy; must-start.

items.text: LOVE DeVonta Smith @ TEN: 27% target share and 13.7 aDOT (3 deep looks) Week 1; TEN allowed 85% catch rate/16 YPR to Jets WRs; bounceback expected.
items.why: Strong usage + soft matchup after tough Week 1.
